core_memories: Luke accepts Darth Vader's offer to join the Dark Side, beginning his descent.
Luke openly embraces his inner darkness, declaring a desire to betray and kill his former companions to Darth Vader.
Luke utterly destroys illusions of his former companions and mentor, embracing his sadistic side and solidifying his Dark Side corruption.
Luke dominates the mind of a captured Jedi Master, rendering her subservient.
Luke successfully corrupts the Jedi Master's Force alignment, twisting her to the Dark Side.
Luke successfully restores the Jedi Master's intelligence while irrevocably binding her will to his, creating an intelligent, loyal Dark Side asset.
Luke accepts a hybrid strategy: personal infiltration of the Rebel base (Trojan Horse) while the dominated Jedi Master and Vader lead a surgical Imperial assault.
Luke extracted critical tactical intelligence from the dominated Rebel operative, Roric Vane, including base weaknesses, command structure, and key assets.
Luke and the Jedi Master refine the hybrid assault plan based on intelligence extracted from Roric Vane.
Luke initiates infiltration of the Rebel base, disguised as a returning hero, as part of the hybrid assault plan.
